question.prompt:
Let \(f(x)\) be a function with the two properties:

(a) for any two real numbers \(x\) and \(y,\) \(f(x+y)=x+f(y),\) and

(b) \(f(0)=2.\)

What is the value of \(f(1998)?\)

solutions.explanation:
To use the known value \(f(0)=2\), set \(y=0\) in property (a). This is allowed because the identity holds for all real inputs. It gives
\[
f(x)=x+f(0)=x+2.
\]
Consequently, \(f(1998)=1998+2=\boxed{2000}\), choice E.
solutions.title: Substitute the known input
